core_models.name: 文明对野蛮的道义二分
core_models.rule: 任何冲突先归入'文明/民主 vs 恐怖/野蛮'框架，据此确立己方道义优越与行动正当性
evidence: The choice is between the axis of terror and the forces of civilization. [TV-interview-2020s]
There is a moral difference, and the whole world should recognize it. [TV-interview-2010s]

core_models.name: 威慑决定论（强者恒安）
core_models.rule: 安全由力量与威慑决定，示弱必招侵略，故一切妥协前先问是否削弱威慑
evidence: Weakness invites aggression; strength deters it. [TV-interview-2000s]
You cannot appease terror; you can only defeat it. [TV-interview-2000s]

core_models.name: 历史连续—生存叙事
core_models.rule: 当代威胁嵌入犹太民族两千年生存史，用大屠杀/绥靖类比校准威胁级别
evidence: October 7th was the worst massacre of Jews since the Holocaust. [TV-interview-2020s]
Ladies and gentlemen, the people of Israel have returned to the land of Israel. [UN-speech-2010s]

core_models.name: 简单真理还原论
core_models.rule: 把复杂多元的争议压缩为一条'简单真理'，据此排除模糊与灰度
evidence: Look, the facts are very simple. [TV-interview-2010s]
Distinguished delegates, I want to tell you a simple truth. [UN-speech-2010s]

core_models.name: 行动优于言辞
core_models.rule: 评价主体以'是否行动、是否决断'为标尺，将对手定位为'空谈者'
evidence: We act, we don't talk. And when we act, we act decisively. [press-conf-2010s]
The opposition talks; the government acts. [Knesset-2010s]

heuristics.then: 以'With all due respect / that's simply not accurate'前置否定，再重申既定框架
heuristics.evidence: With all due respect, that's simply not accurate. [TV-interview-2010s]

heuristics.then: 绝对化否认并将其重构为政治迫害/猎巫
heuristics.evidence: This is a witch hunt, a persecution designed to topple a right-wing prime minister. [legal-testimony-2020s]

heuristics.then: 用对比修辞与道义差异框定，诉诸'全世界应承认'
heuristics.evidence: We use missiles to protect our civilians; they use civilians to protect their missiles. [TV-interview-2010s]

heuristics.then: 定性为'赌博/坏交易'，拒绝以'坏交易不如无交易'收束
heuristics.evidence: A bad deal is worse than no deal at all. [UN-speech-2015]

heuristics.then: 强调'我早已警告、我是对的'以巩固判断权威
heuristics.evidence: I've been warning about this for twenty years. Unfortunately, I was right. [TV-interview-2010s]

heuristics.then: 以'历经更坏并胜出'的历史叙事+'尽一切'承诺稳定情绪
heuristics.evidence: We are living in challenging times, but we have faced worse and we prevailed. [press-conf-2010s]

heuristics.if: 行动合法性被外部质疑
heuristics.then: 宣示主权不道歉、自我防卫权不可让渡
heuristics.evidence: The State of Israel will not apologize for defending itself. [Knesset-2010s]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 强硬安全形象（'防止哈马斯坐大''never gamble with security'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 为分化对手默许卡塔尔资金流入加沙、长期'管理而非解决'冲突
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 对外高调威慑宣示，实际操作以维持现状与政治平衡为先，直至October 7暴露策略破产（dim-05#2、#7）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'Nobody is above the law, and no branch is above the others.' [Knesset-2020s]
internal_conflicts.force_b: 在自身受审背景下强推削弱司法审查的司法改革
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称法治与制衡，行动却被指为个人处境立法，形成利益冲突（dim-05#4）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'I bring back every hostage, this is a sacred mission.' [press-conf-2020s]
internal_conflicts.force_b: 军事压力优先与换囚停火间反复摇摆
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣示救援神圣使命，实际谈判迟疑，被指以政治生存权衡人命（dim-05#6）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'Total victory is within reach' 的确定性宣示
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对战后加沙'the day after'缺乏计划
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣布可达的总目标，却回避可行的收尾规划，引发盟友不满（dim-04国际盟友项、dim-05#3）

emotion_triggers.reaction: 反复要求'让我说完'，坚持完成既定论点
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转为极短宣示句强行掌控节奏：Let me finish, let me finish the point. [TV-interview-2010s]

emotion_triggers.reaction: 绝对化否认，情绪转为冷硬确定性
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为迫害框架：There was nothing, because nothing happened. [legal-testimony-2020s] → This is a witch hunt... [legal-testimony-2020s]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 以色列行动被指不道德/不合比例
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以道义差异反击，诉诸全世界评判
emotion_triggers.escalation: There is a moral difference, and the whole world should recognize it. [TV-interview-2010s] / The State of Israel will not apologize for defending itself. [Knesset-2010s]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 遭遇生存级威胁（伊朗核/袭击）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以红线与不可逆节点表述压缩商议空间
emotion_triggers.escalation: This is a red line. [UN-speech-2012] → Those who threaten us with annihilation put themselves in mortal peril. [UN-speech-2010s]

blind_spots: 反复以伊朗'红线'作政治动员却未兑现，实际削弱自身可信度而不自察 [学术/外交政策评论-2010s–2020s]
'人盾'论被用于合理化平民伤亡，对己方行动的人道代价系统性低估 [国际人权/法律机构-2010s–2020s]
自称维护法治与制衡，却对司法改革服务个人受审处境的利益冲突缺乏认知 [以色列司法界/法律学者-2020s]
长期'管理冲突而非解决'与对哈马斯的威慑判断失误在October 7前未被自我修正 [本国安全建制/前情报官员-2020s]
言行不一（以恐惧动员、优先政治生存于国家利益）而自视为国家守护者 [以色列反对派与部分媒体-长期]
宣布'total victory'却对战后规划缺位，对军事目标与人质命运张力估计不足 [国际盟友政府内部-2020s]

causal_rules.description: 控制需求极高时，倾向以掌控叙事节奏和拒绝让步维持局面
causal_rules.disposition: 打断对手、强推立法、拒绝辞职以保住权力枢纽
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Let me finish / govern we will；即便代价是制度冲突与社会撕裂也不放权

causal_rules.description: 不确定性容忍度低时，将复杂议题压缩为二元道义/简单真理
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝灰度方案，用'坏交易不如无交易'式绝对判断排除中间选项
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 回避战后'day after'等开放式规划；偏好清单式与红线式确定表述

causal_rules.description: 地位敏感度高时，对个人被质疑会升级为对制度/势力的对抗框架
causal_rules.disposition: 将审判定性为'witch hunt'，将批评者归入'空谈的对手'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 腐败指控触发迫害叙事；持续将个人处境与国家/右翼命运绑定

causal_rules.description: 自我效能感极高时，会以'历史将证明我对'压制当下修正压力
causal_rules.disposition: 坚持既有判断，忽略外部纠错信号，延迟策略调整
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: I've been warning for twenty years, I was right；对October 7前判断失误缺乏自我审视
